row.evidence: Wiz's pricing page is a custom-quote form (Wiz One, Wiz Go, à la carte), its product docs sit behind a login, and the public IdP listings (Okta OIN, Entra tutorial) show SAML SSO with JIT provisioning only.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices; Wiz One, Wiz Go and à la carte offerings are sold via a pricing-request form. Wiz product docs (docs.wiz.io) require a customer login and refused every fetch, so SCIM availability cannot be checked publicly. Okta's OIN app ticks SAML only (no SCIM); the Entra gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT provisioning. Status stays unknown rather than none because the docs are not public.

plans.name: Custom quote (Wiz One, Wiz Go, à la carte)
plans.notes: The page names Wiz One, Wiz Go and À la Carte as tabs; no prices are shown.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as checked (read from page markup); SCIM and provisioning actions unchecked. Last updated Jun. 17 2025.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Wiz SSO': SAML SSO with JIT provisioning; no Entra provisioning tutorial in the SaaS-apps index.

jumpcloud.notes: No Wiz entry in JumpCloud's integrations or support sitemaps.
